Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key. Source: metabolism table. Join: substrate_record_id mandatory inner join to compound_records (substrate side) then mandatory inner join to compound_structures for canonical_smiles; metabolite_record_id optional left join to compound_records (metabolite side) for metabolite_compound_key. Filter: none. Sort: canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key. Limit: first 200 rows.
